resources.string: Pair the printer first in Android Bluetooth settings, then choose it here. Receipts are printed as a picture, so Arabic prints correctly on any ESC/POS printer.
No paired devices. Pair the printer in Bluetooth settings, then tap Refresh.
The test page was sent to the printer.
Bluetooth access is not allowed. Tap Allow Bluetooth access.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on and try again.
Could not reach the printer. Check that it is on, close to the phone and paired.
